text:
incident-bot: ALERT: SEV-High - gpu-prefill oom storm in inference-prod-eu-west-1c :rotating_light:

oncall-maya: seeing repeated CUDA OOMs on prefill path, containers restarting rapidly. root ts: 2472001234

zayn: confirmed. large single-shot uploads (some >100k tokens) cause runtime to attempt full kv allocation, then CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY -> container OOMKill. stack shows kernel allocation failure and immediate container restart.

kavi: what's the customer impact surface?

oncall-maya: roughly 2.5% of /v1/chatgen requests for model/redwood-zeta-xl  returned 5xx and the gateway retried at higher concurrency, amplifying pressure. One customer (CUST-5555) running transcript concatenation looks like the origin. tagging @sara for outreach.

sara: messaged CUST-5555 asking them to pause large-batch ingests and to switch to chunked uploads. they're cooperative and asked for ETA and a short note for their engineers.

eng-oncall: quick mitigations proposed: 1) immediate gateway prefill cap to 24k tokens with trim_prefix action, 2) route requests with header x-context-size>24k to a slower safe-path pool backed by 48k-quantized model variant (lower kv footprint), 3) place a short-lived per-key large-context burst limit (50 requests / 10m), 4) cordon the flapping node and reschedule pods. avoid changing node GPU allocations in-prod.

zayn: runtime snippet for reference:

```
[2026-03-16T07:01:34Z] kv_cache.cpp:334 allocate_cache(bytes=610000000) -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-16T07:01:34Z] containerd: Restarting container inference-runner id=ghi789 due to OOMKill
[2026-03-16T07:01:35Z] kubelet: Pod inference-runner-abc OOMKilled
```

ops-bot: automated suggestion: set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=24576 and enable GRACEFUL_KV_EVICTION=true. This requires manual rollout.

pete: agree with gateway cap. I'll add a rule in gateway to trim and reject repeat offenders after 3 attempts. Also prepare a rate-limit rule for large-context bursts keyed by api-key.

oncall-maya: applying gateway cap 24k on canary (1/3 pods), action=trim_prefix. Rolling now.

eng-oncall: deploying routing rule to direct x-context-size>24000 to model-redwood-zeta-48k-quant (safe-path) and disabling streaming prefill there to reduce transient kv pressure.

zayn: canary metrics look promising. container restart rate in the affected AZ down from 14/min to ~2/min. GPU mem utilization dropped from ~95% to ~72% after canary.

datadog-bot: metric update: gpu_mem_utilization (inference-prod-eu-west-1c) 95% -> 72% within 10m of gateway canary. request_error_rate /v1/chatgen down 60%.

sara: sent interim customer note: "We've applied safeguards to limit extremely large prefill allocations and asked you to pause batch ingest. We'll follow up with a log sample and an ETA for long-term fix." Customer asked if we can accept chunked ingestion immediately; ops advised yes and shared upload doc.

zayn: dev reproduction command (dev env only):

```
# dev repro: simulate large prefill
python dev/simulate_large_prefill.py --model redwood-zeta-xl --tokens 125000 --parallel 2
```

eng-oncall: additional short-term steps: noisy-key throttle applied (api-key x-REDACTED), node cordoned and pods rescheduled, temporary suppression window for noisy alerts configured.

kavi: note: we saw one node briefly flap due to repeated OOMs; kubelet restarted the container runtime and we cordoned the node. no underlying hardware alarms. Keeping cordon until morning.

ops-bot: note: recommendation to implement incremental/staged prefill in runtime (chunk KV allocs) and to add a memory-aware eviction policy. These require a release.

eng-oncall: owners and ETAs for post-incident work: staged prefill prototype -> zayn (2 weeks), graceful kv-eviction design -> kavi (3 weeks), per-key large-context quotas -> pete (1 week for gateway rules), docs for safe prefill limits -> product/docs (sara) 1 week.

oncall-maya: handing off to daytime oncall @eng-oncall in 25m. please confirm gateway cap state, routing, noisy-key throttle, and cordoned node on takeover.

eng-oncall: taking handoff. confirmed: gateway cap live (3/3 pods), safe-path routing active, noisy-key throttle enabled, node cordoned. will monitor for 90 minutes and prepare postmortem draft.

oncall-maya: closing thread unless recurrence seen. great triage and quick mitigations everyone. :clap:

incident-bot: Incident 2472001234 marked MITIGATED by eng-oncall at 2472004834
